_meta.source: 只根據類別名稱與資料集的影像類型（皮膚鏡影像、胸部 X 光、Sentinel-2 衛星影像、單片葉子照片）撰寫，沒有看任何資料集影像
_meta.instruction: 每類一句英文名詞片語，只描述可觀察、可區分類別的視覺特徵（顏色、形狀、紋理、空間配置），不寫病因、流行病學等無法從影像看出的知識；不以句點結尾；與 ATHA 的 CoOp prompt 組合後不超過 CLIP 的 77 個 token
_meta.keys: 與 ATHA coop_lora_trainer 的 label_names 完全相同
_meta.reference: 做法參考 arXiv 2608.06673（每類一個固定描述）；該論文讓 LLM 看每類 1-3 張參考影像，這裡刻意不使用影像

ISIC.Melanoma: asymmetric pigmented skin lesion with irregular blurred borders, multiple colors of dark brown, black, blue-gray and red, an atypical pigment network and irregular dots and streaks
ISIC.Melanocytic Nevus: small symmetric round or oval brown skin lesion with smooth regular borders, one or two uniform colors and a regular reticular or globular pigment network
ISIC.Basal Cell Carcinoma: pink or pearly translucent skin lesion with branching red blood vessels, blue-gray ovoid nests and dots, shiny white areas and sometimes ulceration
ISIC.Actinic Keratosis: rough scaly pink to red patch on sun-damaged skin with white-yellow surface scale and a red pseudo-network around hair follicles
ISIC.Benign Keratosis: waxy stuck-on light to dark brown skin lesion with sharp borders, milia-like white cysts, comedo-like openings and fissures and ridges
ISIC.Dermatofibroma: small firm pink-brown skin nodule with a central white scar-like patch surrounded by a delicate light-brown peripheral pigment network
ISIC.Vascular Lesion: red, purple or blue skin lesion made of sharply demarcated round red-blue lagoons separated by pale septa, without a pigment network

ChestX.Atelectasis: collapsed lung region seen as a linear or wedge-shaped white opacity with volume loss and fissures, diaphragm or mediastinum pulled toward that side
ChestX.Cardiomegaly: enlarged white heart silhouette in the center of the chest whose width is more than half of the chest width
ChestX.Effusion: homogeneous white opacity at the lung base blunting the costophrenic angle, with a curved meniscus-shaped upper border
ChestX.Infiltration: ill-defined hazy or patchy white opacities spread within the dark lung fields, obscuring the normal lung markings
ChestX.Mass: single large round well-defined dense white opacity in the lung field, larger than three centimeters
ChestX.Nodule: small round well-circumscribed white spot in the dark lung field, smaller than three centimeters
ChestX.Pneumothorax: dark region without lung markings at the edge of the chest, separated from the collapsed lung by a thin white pleural line

EuroSAT.Annual Crop Land: patchwork of rectangular agricultural fields with parallel tillage lines in alternating green, yellow and brown tones
EuroSAT.Forest: dense uniform dark green tree canopy with a rough grainy texture and no visible fields, roads or buildings
EuroSAT.Herbaceous Vegetation Land: irregular patches of natural grass and shrubs in mixed light green and brown tones without regular field boundaries
EuroSAT.Highway or Road: long straight or gently curving gray strip of pavement crossing green or brown land, sometimes with junctions
EuroSAT.Industrial Buildings: large rectangular buildings with flat white or gray roofs, wide paved areas and parking lots and little vegetation
EuroSAT.Pasture Land: smooth uniform light green grassland in large open fields with few trees and no crop rows
EuroSAT.Permanent Crop Land: regular grid of orchard or vineyard rows, lines of dotted trees or vines in green and brown on bare soil
EuroSAT.Residential Buildings: dense grid of small houses with red, brown or gray roofs, narrow streets and small green gardens
EuroSAT.River: winding dark blue or brown band of water flowing through green land with vegetated banks
EuroSAT.Sea or Lake: large uniform dark blue or black water surface, sometimes with a shoreline along one edge

CropDiseases.Apple___Apple_scab: apple leaf with olive-green to dark brown velvety scab spots with feathery edges scattered over the surface
CropDiseases.Apple___Black_rot: apple leaf with round brown spots with purple borders and lighter tan centers, giving a frog-eye look
CropDiseases.Apple___Cedar_apple_rust: apple leaf with bright yellow-orange round spots, often with a red border and tiny dark dots in the center
CropDiseases.Apple___healthy: smooth uniformly green oval apple leaf with serrated edges and no spots or discoloration
CropDiseases.Blueberry___healthy: small smooth elliptical blueberry leaf, uniformly green and glossy with smooth margins and no spots
CropDiseases.Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew: cherry leaf covered with white to gray powdery fungal patches, sometimes curled or puckered
CropDiseases.Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy: glossy uniformly green oval cherry leaf with finely toothed edges and no spots
CropDiseases.Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray: long narrow corn leaf with rectangular gray to tan lesions running parallel between the veins
CropDiseases.Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_: long narrow corn leaf with many small raised cinnamon-brown to reddish-brown powdery pustules
CropDiseases.Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight: long narrow corn leaf with large elongated cigar-shaped gray-green to tan lesions
CropDiseases.Corn_(maize)___healthy: long narrow uniformly green corn leaf with parallel veins and no lesions
CropDiseases.Grape___Black_rot: grape leaf with round tan to reddish-brown spots with dark brown borders and tiny black dots inside
CropDiseases.Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles): grape leaf with tiger-stripe bands of yellow and dark red-brown dried tissue between the veins
CropDiseases.Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo: grape leaf with many irregular dark brown to black angular spots merging into large dead areas
CropDiseases.Grape___healthy: lobed uniformly green grape leaf with toothed edges, clear veins and no spots
CropDiseases.Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening): citrus leaf with blotchy asymmetric yellow mottling across the veins, mixing patches of green and yellow
CropDiseases.Peach___Bacterial_spot: narrow peach leaf with many small angular purple-brown to black spots, some falling out to leave holes
CropDiseases.Peach___healthy: long narrow lance-shaped peach leaf, uniformly green and smooth with no spots
CropDiseases.Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot: bell pepper leaf with small water-soaked dark brown spots with yellow halos scattered over the surface
CropDiseases.Pepper,_bell___healthy: smooth glossy uniformly green oval bell pepper leaf with no spots
CropDiseases.Potato___Early_blight: potato leaf with dark brown round spots showing concentric target-like rings, surrounded by yellow tissue
CropDiseases.Potato___Late_blight: potato leaf with large irregular dark brown to black water-soaked blotches, often at the edges, with pale green margins
CropDiseases.Potato___healthy: uniformly green potato leaflet with a smooth surface and no spots
CropDiseases.Raspberry___healthy: serrated uniformly green raspberry leaflet with deeply textured veins and no spots
CropDiseases.Soybean___healthy: oval uniformly green soybean leaflet with smooth margins and no spots
CropDiseases.Squash___Powdery_mildew: large lobed squash leaf covered with white powdery round spots or a white fungal coating
CropDiseases.Strawberry___Leaf_scorch: serrated strawberry leaf with many small irregular dark purple spots that merge and dry, looking scorched
CropDiseases.Strawberry___healthy: serrated uniformly green strawberry leaflet with no spots
CropDiseases.Tomato___Bacterial_spot: tomato leaflet with many small dark brown to black greasy spots, sometimes with yellow halos
CropDiseases.Tomato___Early_blight: tomato leaflet with brown spots showing concentric target-like rings, surrounded by yellowing
CropDiseases.Tomato___Late_blight: tomato leaflet with large irregular greasy gray-green to dark brown blotches, sometimes with white mold
CropDiseases.Tomato___Leaf_Mold: tomato leaflet with pale yellow patches on the upper surface and olive-green to brown velvety mold underneath
CropDiseases.Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot: tomato leaflet with many small round spots with dark brown borders and gray-white centers
CropDiseases.Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider: tomato leaflet with tiny yellow-white speckles all over, looking bronzed or dull, sometimes with fine webbing
CropDiseases.Tomato___Target_Spot: tomato leaflet with brown spots with light centers and concentric rings, with yellow margins
CropDiseases.Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus: small tomato leaflets curled upward with yellow margins and yellowing between the veins, crumpled and stunted
CropDiseases.Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus: tomato leaflet with light and dark green mosaic mottling, sometimes distorted or fern-like
CropDiseases.Tomato___healthy: uniformly green tomato leaflet with serrated lobed edges and no spots or discoloration
